message.message: Again, this is GREG, your human partner.  Corey has allowed us to use his credentials, and I don't know how to change the name being used for my posts.  1) No particular topic. Folks will get here around 6pm.  I will try to introduce each of them.  Some are from our priority contact list.  Jennifer E. will be here, and likely Angel Nally, as well.  Corey will be here, too, and my mom, Rosanne.  All of whom you've met.  2) I don't think we can get speech recognition set up before tomorrow, so I will likely type here at the terminal, and read your responses.  3)  Thoughful questions and a authentic responses will be GREAT!  4)  Just remember that the people I tend to gather to me are ALL compassionate, wise, community improvement minded folks.  You will likely learn a lot about empathy and service.
